description:
Krita is an excellent illustration program. It has all the features you would need to create stunning artworks, is well optimized and is intuitive if you know how to use image editing software. Its brush engine is powerful, it supports a wide range of file formats (though webp files can be iffy at times), you can heavily customize your workspace (If you have a second monitor you can make full use of it).

In general, you should take it that if you need a feature, Krita likely has it, although You may need to enable its docker (Settings>Dockers), like for the new text tool. Krita also has good documentation - Press F1 and it'll open it in your browser. In there you should find all the information you need to get started.

Overall, Krita is an excellent raster illustration software and it's the best you could find on the free market for intermediate and advanced work.

description:
Best free painting program I've used; it's optimized well and everything is where you would expect, so the learning curve isn't too difficult. Helped me get back into digital art :D Animation editor is still a bit limited, but it's perfect for short loops

description:
Krita was a great piece of software, it had its usual open source ux pains, but it was great for just drawing stuff. Somehow the performance got worse and worse over time, to the point that i cannot edit images bigger that ~2000x2000 pixel.

In addition, they decided to make the text tool even worse then it was before, to the point that I decided to put Krita at rest until the developers start to finally do some proper UX and performance fixing.

It used to allow me to enter my own text in an editor. Now the "Text" tool only allows the string "Placeholder Text" and you can't paste over this. If you like that string on your image, fine. If you want something else, get a different application that allows you to type your own text string..

Now, it does take some hotkey tweaking to work more efficiently, otherwise, the digital brushes are very detailed and more-so on the realistic side. I like to draw more stylized and I love how the brushes add a more hand-painted look!

I love that this software is open source and I will always reccomend it to friends/folks who ask or want to get into drawing.

This program is also amazing at recovering unsaved work, and I'm hopful to see where it goes with future updates!

Seriously, play around in this application and see what the tools can do! customize your hotkeys and setup to work for you & remember to CTRL + S often! (save)
